latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Image Generation.

- Instantly generate AI-powered video clips from text prompts or uploaded images/videos (JPG, PNG, WEBP, MP4, up to 200MB).
- No editing skills required: simply describe your desired video and export ready-to-use 1080p MP4 files.
- Anonymous, fast sign-up with automatic free token provisioning (100 credits valid for 7 days).
- Seamless workflow: upload → generate → preview timeline → export.
- Session-based editing for batch, quick, or iterative video creation.
- Everything runs in the cloud — no downloads or complex setup needed.
